title: Typesafe Compose Js Stores
description: Implement typesafe compose/js stores: typed KitEvent wire, GraphQL/schema tests, per-event subscriptions, remove command leaks from public API, migrate compose/react and compose/sketchpad off kitWire/executeComposeKitCommand.
summary: GraphQL: KitStoreBatchResult now exposes KitChangeSemanticKind enum + changeKindOther; authorsShallow is [AuthorShallowRow!]! (removed AuthorShallowList scalar). Rust kit_graphql implements AuthorShallowRow + semantic kind split. JS: KitChangeSemanticKindGql, kitChangeSemanticKindToWire, KitStoreBatchResultRow typed inverse as ChangeKitCommandWire[], batch mutation requests changeKindOther, changeKitWithInverse returns KitChangeKindWire + typed inverse. React: KitHostGraphOp uses Type/Design/Piece/Connection DTO ids and Plain/Diff types; added kitHostUndo/kitHostRedo; sketchpad undo/redo uses them. Regenerated compose/graphql/schema.graphql. Tests: cargo test --lib, nx build compose/graphql, @semio-tech/compose-js build+vitest (+new semantic kind test), @semio-tech/compose-react build+vitest.
